up: List all molecules that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1135798. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL identifier, its preferred name (if any), its maximum development phase, its molecule type (e.g., Small molecule, Protein, etc.), and its canonical SMILES. Sort the results ascending by the molecule's ChEMBL identifier.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase AS max_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135798' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
